summary: Amanda Taylor, 31, of Vernal, Utah, went missing after the 7-person private raft she was in went over a diversion dam on the Arkansas River near Salida on Saturday night (~10 p.m.); the raft flipped in the ~8-ft drop and dumped everyone aboard. Five companions made it to shore; David Torchia, 22, clung to the overturned raft for about an hour and was pulled out by Salida firefighters, then treated for bruises and hypothermia. The search for Taylor continued Monday.
location: Arkansas River near Salida (diversion dam; put in at Fisherman's Bridge south of Buena Vista)
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; Salida Fire Department; Chaffee County Search and Rescue; Chaffee County EMS; Colorado State Parks
notes: 'assist' follows index convention for unresolved missing-person searches (cf. id 625); Taylor still missing with search continuing as of the 2014-07-01 report. Incident Saturday night 2014-06-28 (Saturday-verified); 911 call ~10:30 p.m.; group put in at Fisherman's Bridge south of Buena Vista intending to reach the Salida boat ramp ~10 p.m. but missed the ramp in darkness; raft owner John Spalvins, 54, of Littleton; also aboard Alex Marzec, Ashley Noble, Jill Bryant, John Wallace; empty raft recovered ~2 a.m. Sunday ~1/2 mi north of Salida's F Street Bridge; County Undersheriff John Spezze. Run 580: Mountain Mail 'River claims six lives' 2014 season roundup appended (parent-opened this run); confirms Amanda Taylor ejected from a private raft June 28 over the lowhead dam north of Salida, brother found her body July 2 near the South Arkansas/Arkansas confluence.
